purpose: Research-frozen copy of the high-frequency observations used by published analyses. The live file may be refreshed (pnpm hf:acquire); frozen-input checks and research reproduction use this snapshot instead of the live file.

frozen_by: v1.72-v1.83 Local Projection and Panel LP outputs
v1.88 country lag-identifiability audit and Phase B

rule: Published research outputs remain tied to this snapshot until a deliberate re-estimation release replaces them; a live-data refresh alone does not change any frozen output or invalidate any published study.
reproduction: Scripts that read the live file directly and are themselves hash-frozen by a preregistration (e.g. scripts/var-country-identifiability/extract_production.mjs, frozen by the v1.90 design) must be re-run from a checkout of the corresponding release commit, where the live file equals this snapshot; build-time provenance checks use scripts/lib/frozen-inputs.mjs and scripts/lib/frozen_inputs.py.
refresh_procedure: pnpm hf:acquire refreshes the live file; frozen outputs and published studies are unaffected; re-estimating LP, Panel LP or VAR outputs on refreshed data is a separate, deliberate release
